instruction.text: Select the 2 green books to take them away.
instruction.sound: There are 3 books here. Take the two green books away by selecting them.
How many books are left now? Select the correct number.

trainers.finishSound: ssml: Exactly, three books<break time='100ms'/> minus two books<break time='100ms'/> equals one book.

instruction.text: Select the 3 brown teddies to take them away.
instruction.sound: There are 5 teddies here. Select the 3 brown teddies to take them away.
How many teddies are left now?

trainers.finishSound: ssml: Correct. 5 teddies<break time='100ms'/> minus three teddies<break time='100ms'/> equals two teddies.

instruction.text: Select the 2 red butterflies to take them away.
instruction.sound: There are 4 butterflies here. Select the 2 red butterflies to take them away.
How many butterflies are left now?

trainers.finishSound: ssml: Correct - four butterflies<break time='100ms'/> minus two butterflies<break time='100ms'/> makes two butterflies.

instruction.text: Select the 4 yellow pears to remove them.
instruction.sound: Here there are 7 pears. Select the 4 yellow pears to take them away.
How many pears do you see now? Select the correct number.

trainers.finishSound: ssml: Seven pears<break time='100ms'/> minus four pears<break time='100ms'/> makes three pears. Great! <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>apple-bite</voice>
